title: Bill 104 kitchenettes for rebuilding homes
summary: Bill 104 before the County Council would let owners add two kitchenettes to a main home, and the fire department warned this can add density on the same lot. The option for kitchenettes in additional dwelling units was removed, and the department will recommend fire protection measures if it passes.

timeline.text: If the bill passes, the fire department will recommend fire protection measures that owners must install.
The option for kitchenettes in additional dwelling units was removed from the bill.
The fire department said more kitchens on one lot can mean more people, vehicles and density on the same size lot.
Bill 104 before the County Council would let owners add two kitchenettes to a main home for extra living space.
A fire chief said bills to speed the rebuild are moving, but the department is stressing building back safe.
